CASE FILE: WB-10
UNIT: WEB APPLICATION REVIEW
STATUS: OPEN

A public archive portal was recovered from an old records workstation. Staff members reported that the portal sometimes displayed a different document after a browser refresh, even when the user had not selected a new record.

The recovered interface says that the current archive slot is maintained by the browser. The original access-control review was never completed.

OBJECTIVE
Inspect the portal's browser storage, identify the value used to select an archive record, and determine whether changing that value reveals a restricted bulletin.

The restricted bulletin contains the recovery marker required for this case.

EXHIBIT A — local North Pier archive portal
EXHIBIT B — application intake report

Use browser developer tools. No scanning of external sites or real accounts is required.
